title: Every calorie has to fight for its life. Red wine didn't make the cut; now I take it in pill form

segments.text: you can have caffeine alcohol I now have pills that have the molecules you want to consume from red wine you can take in pill form I don't drink alcohol because it's too expensive from a caloric perspective three ounces of red wine I think it's 72 calories and I only have 1 957 calories a day to consume it's too expensive for my budget so I don't do it
